PluginData.Author: LoneWolf2K
PluginData.Tooltip: Dock camera at your connectors and a barrel view for turrets, with mouse-wheel zoom.
PluginData.Description:
A dock camera, until SE2 gets a camera block.
In the cockpit press Alt+Home to look out of a connector of your ship. The view is fixed on what is in front of the connector, and W A S D C Space and the mouse work in the camera's directions. Alt+PageDown / Alt+PageUp switch connectors, the mouse wheel zooms (80° to 6°). Optional: [CAM] in a connector's name names its camera. Take control of a turret and the view moves to its barrel: the mouse aims, the wheel zooms, the turret's angle limits apply.
Other blocks are not cameras in this version. Client side only, changes nothing in the world.
Manual: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Camera-Plugin/blob/main/Docs/UserManual.md Bugs and ideas: https://github.com/lwolf1965/LW-Camera-Plugin/issues
